canonical_example.text: "Mi papel de padre es el más importante de mi vida", declaró el actor recientemente.
canonical_example.translation: "My role as a father is the most important one in my life," stated the actor recently.

canonical_example.translation: They declared a ceasefire and solved the conflict through diplomatic channels.

canonical_example.translation: By the power invested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife.
